title: Irumudi
plot_overview: A man with a violent past has settled into a quiet life with his daughter beside a waterfall. At her request, he takes on a 41-day spiritual vow marked by intense austerity, setting out on a challenging personal journey.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy a drama centered on family, spirituality, and personal change; Not for you if you prefer light stories without themes of violence or demanding religious vows.
review_summary: Pros: spiritual journey; father-daughter bond; personal transformation | Cons: limited plot details; intense austerity; violent past
